description:
Shows the reader's yearly book goal from ReadingRate and their progress toward it: books finished, books left, whether they are on track, the pace needed, and books finished per month. When no goal is set, it says so and suggests one from their past reading. It does not set a goal.

Use when the user asks how they are doing on their reading goal, whether they are on track, or how many books they have read this year.

year.description: The goal year (default: the current year)

name: get_reading_goals

goal.description: target_books, books_read, progress_percent, books_remaining, days_remaining, pace_needed_per_month, on_track, projected_finish

goal_set.description: Whether the reader has set a goal for the year

monthly_breakdown.description: Books finished per month: month, books_read

suggestion.description: A goal suggested from past reading, when none is set

title: Get reading goal progress
